title: Durga Who Carries Across
translation: Salutations always to Durga, who carries us across difficulties, to the essence, the maker of all, to fame, and to the dark and the smoke-coloured one.
translation_hi: दुर्गा को, जो कठिनाइयों से पार लगाती हैं, सार स्वरूपा को, सबकी कर्त्री को, ख्याति को, कृष्णा को और धूम्रा को सदा नमस्कार है।

words.meaning: to her who carries across difficulty
